name: test_real_mask.py
mathematical_scope: Tests numerical Fourier real-mask ranks, category counts and dense orthogonal reconstruction.
input_and_guard_coverage: Even sizes n=4,8,16,32,64,128; no odd size or numerical threshold sensitivity.
costs: Dense eigenbasis construction per case O(n³)/O(n²).
test_evidence: Checks both rank/category counts and residual tolerances, six methods via helper.
acceptance_boundary: Finite numerical evidence for the real-invertible mask constraint; not a complexity win or full theorem certificate.
findings: L7–10 use the even-n rank formulas, intentionally only on even test sizes.
